nodes.label: Store._clean settings validation against default_settings()
nodes.rationale: Unknown keys are dropped on load, so any new setting must be added to default_settings().

nodes.label: run_all shared by window and --run
nodes.rationale: One user failing doesn't stop others; a rate-limit (exit 4) ends the run; injectable build_loader/download_user/describe_error allow fakes in tests.

nodes.label: Window and --run share data/instakeep.json
nodes.rationale: Two separate processes share one JSON file; Store._mutate re-reads, applies, and writes atomically (temp + os.replace) so neither overwrites the other; RunLock prevents concurrent downloads.

nodes.label: Shared state and thread rules (Store only, RunLock, no Tk in worker)
